newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville leaves next-day power prices unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville leaves next-day power prices unchanged.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration left its next-day power price offers unchanged, the federal power marketing agency said Wednesday.
For Thursday, BPA continued to offer block power during heavy load hours at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $19.50 at the California-Oregon (COB) and Nevada-Oregon (NOB) borders.
Firm sales for all deliveries were still offered at $15.00 per MWh in a block of light-load hours.
Non-firm power between 0700 and 2200 PDT was offered at $18.50 (Northwest) and $20.00 (COB/NOB).
BPA also continued to offer non-firm power during light load and shoulder hours for all delivery points at $15.00-16.00 for Thursday pre-schedulings.
